case_number: 2025 INSC 126; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 4806 OF 2011 WITH CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 4807, 4808, 4809 OF 2011
summary: Validity of teacher appointments; selection committee bias vs audi alteram partem; rule against bias (nemo judex in causa sua) vs fair hearing; presence of relatives on committee creates reasonable likelihood of bias; non-impleadment of selectees at initial stage violates audi alteram partem; bias established through proximity of relationships; marks comparison shows disparity; recusal during interviews insufficient to cure bias; conflict between two natural justice principles resolved in favor of bias rule; appointments vitiated despite later hearing opportunities.
legal_provisions_cited: Panchayat Raj Act Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993 s.40(c), s.100
Madhya Pradesh Panchayat (Appeal and Revision) Rules, 1995 s.3, s.5, Rule 9
A.K. Kraipak v Union of India
State Bank of Patiala v SK Sharma
final_judgment: Appointments set aside; appeals dismissed; High Court judgment upheld.
